summary: Created a six-phase implementation plan for the continuation-pointer field-shape schism, built on the research report's correction (flat continuation_path vs nested continuation_context.handoff_path, not a null-handoff_path defect). Implements Option B: dual-form acceptance in orchestrate-triage-classify.sh and base skill-orchestrate/SKILL.md, plus the dispatch-context normalization the research flagged as a separate gap, hard-engine reader symmetry, a handoff-schema.md rewrite, and a proven-RED-first regression suite at scripts/tests/test-orchestrate-triage-classify.sh.
decisions_made: Option B adopted: relax the two nested-only readers rather than migrate writers onto the nested form. Option A rejected for blast radius (wrap-up.md canonical schema plus three agent Stage 5 templates plus an already-self-consistent hard-mode reader).

skill_write_orchestrator_handoff disposition decided: document as dead, do not delete, do not rewire. The edit is comment-only and lives in a different function from the sibling follow-up targeting skill_postflight_update's status accept-list, so the two cannot collide textually or semantically.
cslib-implementation-hard-agent.md Stage 5 (only continuation_context, hardcoded null, no population instruction) declared an explicit Non-Goal and recorded as a named follow-up for harvest.

Regression-suite sandboxing resolved during planning without needing a STATE_FILE override: a $WORKDIR/.claude/scripts/ workdir shape satisfies deploy-root-guard.sh's */.claude parent-dir requirement and makes PROJECT_ROOT resolve to $WORKDIR. Carried as a Phase 1 Scope Hypothesis requiring implementation-time confirmation, with the justified-override fallback stated.

Three nested-only continuation read sites found in skill-orchestrate/SKILL.md (Stage 4 partial handler, Stage 5 result read, Stage MT-4 implement dispatch bullet) and two in skill-orchestrate-hard/SKILL.md (Stage 4 flat-only, Stage 5 nested-only) -- more sites than the research enumerated; all are covered by Phases 3 and 4.

Mutation-check discipline encoded structurally: Phase 1 (test, proven RED) is a hard dependency of Phase 2 (fix), and Phase 1's success criterion is a NON-ZERO exit with the continuation_path-only fixture reporting handoff_state empty.

Anti-over-relaxation guard added as Fixture C (both forms null must still classify as empty) and precedence guard as Fixture D (continuation outranks blockers), so the relaxation cannot silently widen beyond its intent.

Co-edit safety encoded as a binding constraint in every phase: anchor edits on symbol names and quoted distinctive strings, never line numbers, with a Phase 6 grep confirming the sibling's dispatch_status three-tier validation and its OFF-SCHEMA DISPATCH STATUS banner are undisturbed.
